summary: Iteration 5 diagnostic capture. Executed sandbox purchase flow (localStorage cleared, wisdom_free_counsel_count set high, UPGRADE clicked to open paywall, Subscribe pressed, RC Test Store 'Test valid purchase' clicked, 14s wait). The diagnostic path in revenuecat.js/Paywall.js worked as intended and returned the mismatched entitlement id verbatim. RESULT: entitlement returned by RC is 'Scripture council Pro' (NOT 'pro'). The purchase itself succeeded at RC (receipt granted, 1 active entitlement) — the dashboard entitlement identifier simply does not match the app's expected id 'pro'.

diagnostic_capture.toast_text_verbatim: Purchase received. Entitlement returned: "Scripture council Pro" but the app expects "pro". Ask the site owner to align the identifier.
diagnostic_capture.console_debug_rc_diagnostic_verbatim: [RC] receipt_only diagnostic {expected: pro, active_entitlements: Array(1), all_entitlements: Array(1), customerInfo: Object}
diagnostic_capture.notes: The console.debug object was logged with expanded properties: expected='pro', active_entitlements is Array(1), all_entitlements is Array(1). The single entitlement id string is 'Scripture council Pro' as evidenced VERBATIM in the visible toast (source: Paywall.js line 52 which reads activeEntitlementIds directly from the receipt_only result). Note the likely typo: 'council' should probably be 'counsel' to match the app name 'Wisdom & Word — Counsel from Scripture'.
diagnostic_capture.outcome: receipt_only (not unlocked) — as expected given the entitlement id mismatch

root_cause: RevenueCat dashboard has the entitlement identifier configured as 'Scripture council Pro' (with a space, mixed case, and probable typo). The app code (revenuecat.js line 16 -> REACT_APP_REVENUECAT_ENTITLEMENT_ID env var, currently 'pro') expects lowercase 'pro'. Entitlement lookup uses strict key equality (info.entitlements.active[ENTITLEMENT_ID]), so any casing/spelling difference fails.
recommended_fixes_for_main_agent: OPTION A (recommended): Ask the user to open RevenueCat dashboard -> Entitlements -> rename the entitlement identifier from 'Scripture council Pro' to 'pro' (lowercase, no spaces). The product must remain attached to that entitlement. This is a 30-second dashboard edit; no code change needed.

OPTION B (quick unblock): Change /app/frontend/.env REACT_APP_REVENUECAT_ENTITLEMENT_ID from 'pro' to 'Scripture council Pro' (exact match, spaces preserved) and restart frontend. Works immediately but ties the app to a non-conventional identifier and a probable typo ('council' vs 'counsel').

OPTION C (defensive code): Make the entitlement check permissive — treat ANY active entitlement as Pro (Object.keys(info.entitlements.active).length > 0). Least strict but simplest and robust against future dashboard renames.

integration_issues.issue: RC entitlement identifier 'Scripture council Pro' returned by RevenueCat dashboard does not match the app's expected identifier 'pro'. Purchase succeeds at RC but the app cannot unlock. Diagnostic surfaced in toast and console.debug is functioning perfectly.

action_items: Instruct user to rename the RevenueCat entitlement identifier from 'Scripture council Pro' to 'pro' in the RC dashboard (Entitlements section). Ensure the monthly product remains attached to that renamed entitlement.
As a fallback / immediate unblock, main agent can update REACT_APP_REVENUECAT_ENTITLEMENT_ID env var to match 'Scripture council Pro' exactly.
critical_code_review_comments: The diagnostic implementation (revenuecat.js console.debug + Paywall.js verbose toast) worked exactly as designed — it captured the mismatched id and displayed it to the user/tester. Recommend keeping this diagnostic surfacing in place (perhaps behind a debug flag) since it's extremely useful for troubleshooting misconfigured RC dashboards.

Consider Option C above (permissive entitlement check) as a small hardening — many RC integrations use only one entitlement per app, and matching on 'any active entitlement' avoids this class of bug entirely.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 diagnostic goal is complete. Root cause identified: RC dashboard entitlement id is 'Scripture council Pro' but app expects 'pro'. Once main agent (or user) aligns the identifier via RC dashboard rename OR sets REACT_APP_REVENUECAT_ENTITLEMENT_ID='Scripture council Pro' in /app/frontend/.env + restart frontend, retest by: clearing localStorage, setting wisdom_free_counsel_count high, opening paywall, clicking Subscribe -> Test valid purchase, waiting ~12s. Expected: toast reads 'Welcome — the Elder's counsel is now unlimited to you.', paywall closes, [data-testid="access-pill-pro"] is visible, and reload persists Pro status.
rca of the issue: RevenueCat dashboard entitlement identifier mismatch: the monthly product is attached to an entitlement named 'Scripture council Pro' (visible in customerInfo.entitlements.active), but the client uses ENTITLEMENT_ID='pro' for key lookup. Because the lookup is Boolean(info.entitlements.active[ENTITLEMENT_ID]), any casing/spelling/whitespace difference causes it to evaluate false and the app falls through to receipt_only. Reproduction: set wisdom_free_counsel_count high, click UPGRADE, click Subscribe, click 'Test valid purchase' in the RC Test Store dialog. Mitigation: rename entitlement in RC dashboard to 'pro' (preferred) OR update env var to exact string 'Scripture council Pro'.
